symbols.name: FuncRule
symbols.summary: Represents a rule that is defined by a user-specified predicate function.
symbols.remarks: This class derives from BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.RuleBase and allows for the creation of custom validation rules based on a Func<bool> predicate. If the predicate evaluates to true, the rule is considered satisfied; otherwise, the rule fails. An optional message can be provided to describe the rule.
